newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks extend gains on index-linked buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks extend gains on index-linked buying.

text.p: Tokyo stocks extended their gains in early Monday afternoon trade, lifted by index-linked buying by domestic institutional investors as well as a rebound in some blue chip issues, brokers said. They added that shares of firms which rely on domestic demand were also firm.
By 0412 GMT, the Nikkei average had risen 191.42 points or 0.94 percent to 20,516.15. Its June futures had added 180 points to reach 20,550.
"Blue chips are recovering after the yen strengthened to 115 in the morning. Financial issues are also fairly steady which is lifting the Nikkei average," a "Big Four" broker said.
The main declining sectors were miscellaneous manufacturing, warehousing, precision instruments and communications.
